notes: This entry covers the Osprey Video "Talon G1" H.264 Hardware Encoder (model 96-02010) — a 2-3 channel (datasheet text is inconsistent on channel count) fanless contribution encoder that ingests SDI/HDMI/Composite and streams H.264 over IP (RTMP/RTP/UDP/.TS). Legacy/likely discontinued product: ospreyvideo.com no longer hosts a live product page for it (404s on guessed URLs), so specs were sourced from the manufacturer's official datasheet PDF (copyright Osprey Video AG) as mirrored by two Osprey channel partners/resellers (ezytech.com and advanceddigital.com), cross-checked against B&H's listing (matching dimensions 93.1x120.2x24.75mm and 9-17VDC power spec) — B&H's own page returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch so sourceUrl points to that B&H listing as the preferred-retailer reference even though full confirmation came via the manufacturer PDFs and a search-engine cache of the page. Sibling products exist under the same family with different I/O: "Talon G1 Decoder" (receive-side, not covered here) and "Talon G1H" (HDMI/CVBS-only variant, no SDI/USB-A audio difference). Power connector is inferred as dc-barrel from the included "International Power Supply" accessory and the "9-17VDC" panel label; exact connector geometry not explicitly named in the datasheet. HDMI version/bandwidth grade omitted because the datasheet only states max resolution (1080p/60), not an HDMI spec version.

ports.name: SDI
ports.note: BNC connector; accepts 3G-SDI (SMPTE 424M), HD-SDI (SMPTE 292M), or SD-SDI (SMPTE 259M)

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Max resolution 1080p/60; HDMI version number not stated in datasheet, grade omitted

ports.name: AUDIO
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo analog audio input, front panel 3.5mm jack

ports.name: ETHERNET
ports.note: 1x GigE; carries the encoded H.264/RTMP/RTP/UDP stream and HTTP configuration interface

ports.name: 9-17VDC
ports.note: External DC power input, wide-range 9-17VDC, 6W consumption; ships with an included international power supply (barrel-jack connector inferred from product photos)
